# The call budget is 4. The planner and the three agents of section 1 use it up. The reader of section 2 does not run: the section waits for a person.
# The person adds 2 calls. The reader and the judge of section 2 run, and the writer waits again. The run is cancelled, as an upgrade would strand it,
# and the item runs again with a larger cap. The new run keeps the plan and the finished section 1, so the planner and the agents of section 1 do not run twice.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=4

exec beehavereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &

waitstatus 'paused: The run used all 4 agent calls'
grep -count=1 '^4$' store/cold-cost/calls
grep 'done' store/cold-cost/s1.1/status
! exists wiki.log

# The answer goes to the child run of section 2, whose id is the third run of the desk: research-desk-3.
exec beehavereal answer research-desk-3 2
waitstatus 'paused: The run used all 6 agent calls'
grep -count=1 '^6$' store/cold-cost/calls
exec beehavereal cancel cold-cost
wait

env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=40
exec beehavereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of cold-cost, round 1'
exec beehavereal answer cold-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item cold-cost finished'

# The planner ran once and section 1 ran once. Section 2 ran again from its start, because it was not done.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep -count=1 '^cold-cost-' wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
judge
write Output
read cost
judge
read cost
judge
write Cost
abstract
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
